scope: All twelve public main revisions pinned together at 2026-10-07T19:36:48.761841+00:00, with the vocabulary census, subsets, heatmap record lists and record statistics regenerated at those pins. The site audit records these pins and the live sources checked during the refresh. Merged-PR totals cover all twelve Mechs, culturebotai-claw and CultureBotAI.github.io. They are all-time GitHub counts queried during the refresh, rather than counts cut off at the pin time; the two supporting repositories are recorded separately from Mech record statistics in mech_stats.json. Card sources are published browsers, CultureMech's generated README inventory and DUFMech's frozen seed-family JSON. DUF seed families remain explicitly distinguished from curated mechanism records even though native FamilyRecords are now published. All twelve pinned repositories contain CC BY 4.0 project-data and BSD-3-Clause code licenses, preserving upstream and historical terms. CLAW declares all twelve members. Capability declarations describe contract adoption, not a certification of complete validation coverage or blocking enforcement.

notes.PathwayMech: 156 data/pathways records at the pin and 156 links in the published record browser. They contain 7,307 mechanistic edges across 16 taxa, with 1,203 distinct reference IDs. Current committed outputs include KGX nodes/edges and SSSOM source mappings; availability does not establish kg-microbe ingestion. The optional curation_history schema retains its explicit TaxonMech CurationEvent reference; 88 YAML records contain 110 inline events, while all 156 published pages additionally show separate canonical history. notes.DUFMech: 6,532 seed families in data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-05.json, validated against its frozen manifest: 6,154 UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE and 378 KNOWN_HISTORICAL_DUF. These corrected classifications use the original frozen metadata, not a fresh InterPro retrieval. Each JSON row is one measured family; the TSV is a redundant serialization. Counts, heatmap occurrences and shared-term links continue to measure this seed worklist. Native FamilyRecords now have a LinkML schema and public family pages with evidence, curation history and specific cross-Mech leads, but all families remain UNSCORED. All 6,532 measured Pfam IDs have native page routes. The seed worklist has no review-status field, so the statistics do not infer zero reviewed from the separate native schema. A retained cross-Mech manifest records 16,298 imported evidence-lead rows from seven siblings at its own acquisition pins, distinguishing direct identities, text mentions and protein associations. These leads do not validate a family's function. CLAW now declares DUFMech as a member.
notes.culturebotai-claw: The 7253f80 snapshot declares all 12 canonical fleet members, including DUFMech, 20 governed artifacts and 26 capabilities per member. PathwayMech KGX and SSSOM export contracts remain enabled. The website preserves DUFMech's newly declared adoption states and each capability's reason directly from the upstream manifest.
